title: Order Access
description: A credential bound to a single order. The business issues it at checkout completion so a platform can perform authorized order operations on behalf of a buyer who has no account with the business — the guest case, where Identity Linking has no user to authenticate. The credential authorizes exactly the order it was issued for and confers no other authority: it is not a platform credential, not a user identity token, and cannot be used to discover, list, or reach any other order.

token.description: Opaque, unguessable credential scoped to a single order. Platforms MUST treat it as a secret and MUST NOT place it in a browser-addressable URL. Businesses MUST bind it to one order, MUST reject it for any other resource, and MUST NOT derive it from guessable order attributes.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 expiry timestamp for the credential. Businesses SHOULD set it. When absent, the business governs the lifetime and platforms MUST NOT assume the credential is permanent.

scopes.description: Order operations this credential authorizes, expressed in the UCP scope token grammar (e.g. 'dev.ucp.shopping.order:read'). Scope names are the same vocabulary Identity Linking uses, so a business gates an operation identically whichever way the request was authorized. When absent, the credential authorizes read access to the bound order only.
